provenance_note: Hand-entered procedure. Deadlines and channels were not machine-verified.
claims_administrator: Ping An Pension Insurance Co., Ltd. (Foreign Student Claims Department)
submission_instructions: For hospitalization, notify 400-810-5119 within 48 hours of admission. For outpatient, collect original fapiao and medical records, submit claim online via lxbx.net or mail paper originals to Ping An Beijing Claims Center.
filing_deadlines: Within 60 calendar days from the date of hospital discharge or outpatient consultation
required_forms: International Student Insurance Claim Application Form (来华留学生保险理赔申请书)
submission_channels: Postal mail to Ping An Pension Beijing Center
preauthorization_requirements: Hospitalization requires advance call to 400-810-5119. Emergency admissions must be reported within 48 hours.
reimbursement_procedures: Insurer audits invoices against national medical insurance catalog. Approved funds transferred to claimant mainland China bank card (UnionPay).
published_processing_timeline: 7 to 15 working days upon receipt of complete original evidence documents
dispute_escalation_guidance: Contact Ping An National Customer Service 95511 or escalate to NFRA Financial Consumer Protection Hotline 12378.
